Solution:
We saw this data in section 3.1 example 6. Using STAT-Utility, first type the data into a column
named “Spam Calls.” Then, we follow Descriptive Statistics → Basic Statistics, and check the
column under “Columns to include.” Since this data is from a sample, the default statistics are the
ones we need. We also check “Range (max − min)” under “Statistics to show,” then click “Show
results in a new window.”
